products.name: Workday AI
products.note: HR and finance AI; skills-based talent; predictive analytics; sensitive HR data exposure

profile_text.body:
Workday is a public company, traded as WDAY, founded in 2005 and headquartered in Pleasanton, California. It files with the SEC under CIK 0001327811, and its most recent 10-K reports revenue of $9,552,000,000 for the period ending 2026-01-31. The company's site presents it as an enterprise AI platform for HR, finance, and IT.

Its tracked product is Workday AI, described as HR and finance AI covering skills-based talent and predictive analytics, with sensitive HR data exposure noted as a consideration. The company describes its offering as agentic AI, alongside Sana, that activates teams of specialized agents to perform processes across HR, finance, and IT, and says these agents can find, build, act, and automate rather than only assist. The site frames the pitch around turning AI into ROI faster and around trust, agility, and data readiness.

Court records list nine cases naming Workday, Inc., in federal district courts: the Eastern District of California, the Northern District of Georgia, the Northern District of California, the District of Colorado, the District of Maryland, and the Eastern District of Virginia. Several of these appear more than once, including Meckfessel Poletti v. Workday, Inc. and Hill v. Workday, Inc. A separate tally counts 264 cases in California.
